def langford(n):
    seq=[0]*(2*n)
    # place values descending for speed
    vals=list(range(n,0,-1))
    # domains: start i 0-based with i+v+1 < 2n
    def bt(k):
        if k==len(vals):
            return True
        v=vals[k]
        # try starts 
        for i in range(2*n-(v+1)):
            j=i+v+1
            if seq[i]==0 and seq[j]==0:
                seq[i]=seq[j]=v
                if bt(k+1): return True
                seq[i]=seq[j]=0
        return False
    return seq if bt(0) else None
